description: A React Native component for a developer transfer screen facilitating JSON export/import functionality for notes, including UI elements such as buttons and a text area.

methods.name: DevTransferScreen
methods.description: Main component function providing the developer transfer interface with export/import capabilities.

methods.name: doExport
methods.description: Asynchronous function that exports all data as JSON and updates the text buffer.

methods.name: doImport
methods.description: Asynchronous function that imports JSON data from the buffer.
